observations: Photo 0 shows a pair of clear-lens headlight assemblies sitting on a concrete floor.
Chrome housings with projector-style reflectors, turn-signal segments visible on each unit.
A watermark 'STANLY AUTO SOLUTION' overlays the image, seller/shop branding, not a product label.
No visible manufacturer logo, part number, or 'Honda' text printed on the housings themselves.
Wiring pigtail visible hanging from one unit; connector condition not clearly shown.
Background shows unrelated items (a basket, bags) with no relevance to the part.

claims.claim: Honda CRV full light 2004 (i.e., genuine fitment headlights for a 2004 Honda CR-V)
claims.evidence: No part number, OEM stamp, or 'Honda'/'CR-V' text visible on the housings in photo 0; claim rests only on seller's text.

risks.risk: Fitment may not actually match a 2004 Honda CR-V (could be aftermarket or for a different year/trim).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear housing showing OEM part number or 'HONDA' embossing, or a photo matched against the car's VIN plate.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded headlight pair, not confirmed CR-V fitment

risks.risk: Electrical function (bulbs, wiring, adjusters) is untested.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing both headlights powered on and working (low/high beam, turn signal).

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, fogging, or moisture inside the lens not visible from this single angle.
risks.proof: Additional photos from front, side, and back of each housing in good light.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible condition only, no premium for 'like new' claim

risks.risk: Mounting tabs or brackets could be broken, common in used headlight assemblies.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the mounting tabs and connector housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming tabs intact only if clearly visible, otherwise worst case

proof_requests: Close-up of rear housing showing any OEM part number or Honda markings.
Video of both headlights powered on to confirm all bulbs and signals work.
Additional photos from multiple angles (front, side, back) in clear lighting.
Photo of mounting tabs and connectors for breakage check.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used pair of car headlight assemblies, but the claimed Honda CR-V 2004 fitment and functionality are unverified from the single photo, so it must be priced at worst case as a generic, untested headlight pair.
